title: François Pompon
content: French sculptorFrançois Pomponwas born this day in 1855.At an early age he assisted Rodin, and Rodin said "you will be a great artist."But success came later in life for Mr. Pompon, when in 1922, at age 67, his sculpture of a polar bear won widespread acclaim.Pompon became celebrated during the Art Deco era for his simplified contours and smooth surfaces.Read more aboutFrançois Pomponon Wikipedia.
